articles.summary: As the demand for residential repowering gains momentum, installers and homeowners are increasingly turning to inverter upgrades for aging solar systems. Two recent Solar Builder articles spotlight this trend and prominently feature Tigo Energy technologies.
articles.title: Tigo Energy Featured in Solar Builder Coverage on Repowering

articles.summary: Resource update: TS4-A 725 and TS4-X in PVsyst PVsyst Modeling Now Includes Latest Tigo Product Lines We’ve updated our PVsyst integration guide to include Tigo’s newest optimizer product lines – the TS4-A 725W and the TS4-X series. The updated article walks you through adding these products to PVsyst for accurate system modeling. Read the full guide here: Adding Tigo Optimizers to PVsyst.

articles.summary: The line between technological innovation and applied research is becoming increasingly thin in today’s energy landscape. A concrete example comes from two experimental projects that employ Tigo technology to collect high-resolution performance data at the module level. These projects are promoted by E4C, one installed at the SIRTA atmospheric observatory, in Paris region, and the other is at the UPF Campus.
articles.title: When Solar Meets Science - The Role of PV Monitoring in Applied Research
